exposure: Prior cesarean delivery due to first stage non-progressive labor
Prior cesarean delivery due to second stage non-progressive labor
cohort: 3828 women with a prior cesarean delivery, delivering at Soroka University Medical Center between 1988-2013
finding: Cesarean delivery due to first stage non-progressive labor was independently associated with a recurrent cesarean delivery in the subsequent pregnancy, while prior cesarean delivery due to second stage non-progressive labor was independently associated with preterm birth.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery due to first stage non-progressive labor was independently associated with a recurrent cesarean delivery in the subsequent pregnancy.
